links.scope: The proved odd recurrence concerns reduced abelian complexity of the Thue-Morse word. A010060 is the underlying binary sequence, not the derived complexity sequence. Even recurrence and nonautomaticity remain outside this result.

The paper identifies S_(1,2,3) as A026471 in its greedy 3-sumfree section. Our Conjecture 17 proof requires d >= 2 and g >= d+1. This d=1 seed is not covered; this is a related result, not a resolution of this OEIS sequence.
The paper identifies S_(1,3,4) as A026475. This is a d=1 seed, outside the proved Conjecture 17 parameter range. The separate g+1 seed family is recorded as a follow-up question.
